concept.title: Company and connection for a lonely older person
concept.shortdesc: As an older person who is lonely, I need regular company and activities, so that I feel connected.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-030). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: older people, people who are lonely or isolated.
Situation: Often spread across many activity types; the purpose matters, not the activity.
A good result: Befriending, social groups and drop-ins near her with how to join, including support to get there.
How much it matters: Important: a miss leaves someone without help they need.

ul.li: I'm lonely and want to meet people
